name: NIH Summer Internship Program (SIP)
org: National Institutes of Health, Office of Intramural Training and Education
what_you_do: Work full time for a summer in an NIH research lab with a scientist mentor. You join career workshops and present your work at Summer Poster Day. Open to graduating high school seniors who meet the age rule.
who_can_apply: U.S. citizens or permanent residents who will be 18 by September 30, 2027 and are a high school senior (enrolled at least half-time) who graduates before the internship starts, or a college student. A senior who is 17 on June 1, 2027 but turns 18 by September 30, 2027 must have a permanent home address within 40 miles of an NIH campus.
pay_detail: Stipend, set each year by education level. The page does not state the amount. Free parking. You need proof of health insurance, and NIH does not provide housing.
duration: Full time, between May 10 and August 31, 2027. Exact dates are set with your mentor. No vacations during the internship.
deadline_text: The 2027 application is open now and closes Tuesday, January 26, 2027 at 12 pm ET. Reference letters are due Tuesday, February 2, 2027 at 12 pm ET.
how_to_apply: Apply in the NIH Application Center with your coursework and grades, a resume, a personal statement, and two references. Then email NIH scientists whose work interests you and point them to your application. Scientists pick their own interns and finish by April 1.
notes: Very competitive, and mostly for college students. Only seniors who meet the age rule can apply; juniors cannot. Free online application webinars on Oct 20 and Nov 17, 2026. Questions: SIP@nih.gov.
